occurrences.claim: Bundled 154 routes, 302 schedules, 5,549 departures, and 24x7 state helplines are 100% available offline
occurrences.justification: These assets are embedded directly into production app bundles (routes.json, schedules.json, helplines in code).

occurrences.claim: Saved trips remain 100% readable and executable offline
occurrences.justification: Saved trips and active trip state reside exclusively in local Room SQLite / SwiftData databases.

occurrences.claim: Transit route directory, stop sequences, and scheduled timetables are 100% available offline
occurrences.justification: Pure local JSON asset parsing and KMP timetable evaluator; zero network calls involved.
